marketLayer.title: US Mega-Cap Tech & AI Infrastructure Spending
marketLayer.fact: Major US technology firms announced a collective 25% year-over-year increase in Q2 capital expenditures dedicated to AI hardware and cloud data centers.
marketLayer.inference: Sustained enterprise AI infrastructure spending underpins revenue momentum for semiconductor makers and supply chain partners, though margin pressures may intensify for cloud platforms.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Monetization timeline for enterprise generative AI services and potential supply chain bottlenecks in advanced packaging.

marketLayer.title: Hong Kong Internet Sector & Southbound Capital Flows
marketLayer.fact: The Hang Seng Tech Index rallied 1.8% alongside Southbound net inflows exceeding HKD 4.5 billion via the Stock Connect channel.
marketLayer.inference: Incremental liquidity from mainland institutional investors is helping re-rate valuation multiples across major Chinese internet platforms following stable Q2 earnings previews.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Sustainability of domestic macroeconomic stimulus and broader recovery in mainland consumer confidence.

marketLayer.title: Federal Reserve Policy Expectations & Global Liquidity
marketLayer.fact: US core inflation data matched consensus expectations at 2.6% YoY, reinforcing market pricing for a September Federal Reserve rate cut.
marketLayer.inference: A softening interest rate environment reduces borrowing costs globally, providing valuation relief for interest-rate-sensitive equities across both US and emerging Asian markets.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Potential resurfacing of energy price volatility due to geopolitical friction affecting global inflation trajectories.
